Class IndicatorBank.Session

java.lang.Object
com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.cache.IndicatorBank.Session
Enclosing class:
IndicatorBank
public final class IndicatorBank.Session extends Object
One run's recording and replay decisions.

Recordings are published only by commit(), and only a run that replayed its whole dataset should call it. A run stopped early by a sweep guard holds a series shorter than the dataset, and publishing it would starve the next run mid-replay.

  • Method Details

    • intercept

      public RTIndicator intercept(@NonNull @NonNull String context, @NonNull @NonNull RTIndicator indicator)
      Decides what actually gets registered in place of an indicator: a replay of a series already recorded, a recorder wrapping it, or the indicator untouched.

      An indicator with no signature is unidentifiable and steps aside — the default for everything not explicitly opted in.

      The wrapper matches the shape of what it wraps. Both instrument maps route each registered indicator with instanceof RichRTIndicator and that check inspects the wrapper, so a snapshot-consuming indicator must be wrapped in a snapshot-consuming wrapper or it would silently move onto the scalar dispatch branch and be fed one extracted double instead of the whole snapshot.

      Parameters:
      context - identity of the stream feeding this group: two groups reading different instruments or different snapshot fields produce different series from the same math
      indicator - the indicator about to be registered
      Returns:
      what to register in its place

    • commit

      public void commit()
      Publishes every intact recording this run produced. Call it only after a run that consumed the whole dataset.
